_doc: Trophy Hype discipline taxonomy — the two arenas (FIELD = physical athletics, STAGE = creative submissions) and the disciplines within them. glyph is an emoji used across the UI. The heartbeat and profile match opportunities against these ids.

disciplines.name: Road Running
disciplines.blurb: 5K to marathon on the road — chip-timed, ranked, PR-hunted.

disciplines.name: Trail & Ultra
disciplines.blurb: Trail races and ultras from 50K to 100 miles.

disciplines.name: Triathlon
disciplines.blurb: Swim-bike-run, sprint through full-distance.

disciplines.name: Cycling & Gravel
disciplines.blurb: Road, gravel, and mountain-bike races and gran fondos.

disciplines.name: Obstacle Racing
disciplines.blurb: Spartan, Tough Mudder, ninja and OCR series.

disciplines.name: Peak Bagging
disciplines.blurb: Named summit collections — Colorado 14ers, the Seven Summits, county highpoints.

disciplines.name: Mountaineering
disciplines.blurb: Alpine and expedition climbing, ski-mountaineering.

disciplines.name: Climbing & Bouldering
disciplines.blurb: Sport, boulder, and comp climbing.

disciplines.name: Angling
disciplines.blurb: Master Angler programs, species slams, and tournament fishing.

disciplines.name: Open-Water & Paddle
disciplines.blurb: Open-water swims, SUP, and paddling races.

disciplines.name: Strength Sport
disciplines.blurb: Powerlifting, weightlifting, strongman, functional-fitness comps.

disciplines.name: Martial Arts
disciplines.blurb: Grappling, striking, and open tournaments — ties to the Aether Martial Codex.

disciplines.name: Adventure & Multisport
disciplines.blurb: Adventure races, orienteering, rogaines, and hybrid events.

disciplines.name: Music
disciplines.blurb: Songwriting, production, and beat competitions — the first stage.

disciplines.name: Film
disciplines.blurb: Short and feature film festivals and screenplay competitions.

disciplines.name: Animation & Anime
disciplines.blurb: Animation festivals, anime showcases, and AMV / motion competitions.

disciplines.name: Writing
disciplines.blurb: Fiction, poetry, and nonfiction prizes, anthologies, and open calls.

disciplines.name: Comics & Manga
disciplines.blurb: Comic and manga contests, tapas, and anthology calls.

disciplines.name: Game Dev
disciplines.blurb: Game jams and indie game awards — ship a build, get judged.

disciplines.name: Apps & Software
disciplines.blurb: Hackathons and product competitions for fun and work apps alike.

disciplines.name: Engineering & Design
disciplines.blurb: Civil, hardware, and design competitions — engineer all of it.

disciplines.name: Visual Art
disciplines.blurb: Juried art shows, illustration, and design open calls.

disciplines.name: Photography
disciplines.blurb: Photo contests and portfolio reviews.
